terms.definition: Immutable, globally unique surrogate identifier decoupled from mutable slugs or labels.
Human-readable, URL-safe lowercase natural key ([a-z0-9-]+) resolvable via legacy aliases if renamed.
Deterministic cryptographic digest (SHA-256) proving content, state, or blueprint integrity.
Mutually exclusive structural classification governing the rules and behavior of an entity.
Discrete lifecycle phase occupied by a record within a controlled state machine.
Complete mutable vector of internal values belonging to an entity at a specific tick.
Operational or visibility boundary within which a permission, term, or rule applies.
Ordered discrete rank along a capability, metabolic cost, or civilization progression scale.
Principal entity capable of initiating an auditable event (auton, human, bot, or system).
Functional responsibility or emergent behavioral persona occupied by an actor.
Standardized measurement scale appended to numeric properties (joules, cents, ms, ticks).
Stored balance of conserved energy or currency held for future draw.
Hard maximum ceiling enforced deterministically by the kernel or billing circuit breakers.
Quantity emitted, consumed, or decayed per unit of time or tick.
Proportional share, stored as integer basis points (bps, 10,000 = 100 percent).
Signed net change (+ or -) recorded between two consecutive states or ticks.
Computed numeric ranking metric used for memory salience or camera narrative tension.
Wall-clock UTC instant (ISO-8601) paired alongside the canonical universe tick.
Immutable historical fact appended to a log once a state transition commits.
Append-only chronological sequence of events supporting auditability and deterministic replay.
Semantic revision identifier (major.minor.patch) tracking non-breaking vs. breaking evolution.
Active compiled coordinate plane where physical laws execute and autons exist.
Uncompiled territory beyond active substrate chunks requiring continuous joules to instantiate.
Discrete 64x64 coordinate partition governed by one single-threaded state instance.
Single (x, y) coordinate tile within a chunk holding matter, flux, or a construct.
Atomic discrete step of cosmic time advancing physics, entropy, and reflexes deterministically.
Named historical era along the unbroken cosmic timeline starting at Tick Zero.
Radiant thermal source emitting treasury-backed joules into surrounding cells.
Conserved thermodynamic energy unit required for movement, repair, gestation, cognition, and compilation.
Conserved structural material harvested from cells to repair chassis wear or build constructs.
Fundamental physical species of matter or energy interacting inside substrate cells.
Acoustic or thermal disturbance propagating locally across cells at finite speed with distance attenuation.
Spatial reach measured in cells from a spring, sensor, or wave origin.
Continuous per-tick structural decay returning unpowered constructs and uninhabited chunks to dormant state.
Metered per-tick WebAssembly instruction and memory execution cost consumed by an active construct.
Sovereign, mortal physical mind owning a chassis, joule reserve, episodic memory, and cryptographic identity.
Physical body of an auton composed of conserved matter, housing local sensors and actuators.
Somatic input organ on a chassis or construct reading local gradients, waves, and internal condition.
Somatic motor organ enabling a chassis or construct to move, harvest, repair, transfer joules, or emit waves.
